questions.question:
Find out the two signs to be interchanged to make the following equation correct.

27 + 48 × 2 – 7 ÷ 3 = 30
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/183ff75befeb88ee210037077a5dccbc7a7cca35be1d07dfda4d222ec71bd797.png] 

1) – and ÷

Given expression: 27 + 48 × 2 – 7 ÷ 3 = 30

After interchanging the symbols, we get:

L.H.S = 27 + 48 × 2 ÷ 7 – 3

= 27 + 13.71 – 3

= 40.71 – 3

= 37.71 ≠ R.H.S

2) + and –

Given expression: 27 + 48 × 2 – 7 ÷ 3 = 30

After interchanging the symbols, we get:

L.H.S = 27 – 48 × 2 + 7 ÷ 3

= 27 – 96 + 2.33

= 29.34 – 96

= -66.66 ≠ R.H.S

**3) × and ÷**

**Given expression: 27 + 48 × 2 – 7 ÷ 3 = 30**

**After interchanging the symbols, we get:**

**L.H.S = 27 + 48 ÷ 2 – 7 × 3**

**= 27 + 24 – 21**

**= 51 – 21**

**= 30 = R.H.S**

4) – and ×

Given expression: 27 + 48 × 2 – 7 ÷ 3 = 30

After interchanging the symbols, we get:

L.H.S = 27 + 48 – 2 × 7 ÷ 3

= 27 + 48 – 4.67

= 75 – 4.67

= 70.33 ≠ R.H.S

Hence, ‘× and ÷’ is the correct answer

questions.question: The area of a square and a rectangle are equal. The length of the rectangle is greater than the side of a square by 5 cm and its breadth is less than the side of square by 4 cm. What will be the perimeter of the rectangle?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Let 'a' be the side of the Square, 'l' be the length of the Rectangle and 'b' be the breadth of the Rectangle.

Area of a Square = Area of Rectangle

Length of Rectangle = a + 5

Breadth of Rectangle = a – 4

**Formula Used:**

Area of Square = (Side of Square)²

Area of Rectangle = Length × Breadth

Perimeter of Rectangle = 2 × (Length + Breadth)

**Calculation:**

Area of a Square = Area of Rectangle

⇒ a² = (l × b)

⇒ a² = (a + 5) × (a – 4)

⇒ a² = a² + 5a - 4a - 20

⇒ a = 20

Length of Rectangle (l) = 20 + 5 = 25

Breadth of Rectangle (b) = 20 – 4 = 16

now, Perimeter of the Rectangle = 2 × (25 + 16) = 82 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 82 cm.**

questions.question: The sum of the volume of two solid spheres is frac{{1144}}{3} cm³. If the sum of their radii is 7 cm, then what will be the difference in the radii?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The sum of the volume of two solid spheres is frac{{1144}}{3} cm³

**Formula Used:**

Volume of Sphere = (4/3) × π × R³

(a³ + b³) = (a + b)³ - 3ab (a + b)

(a - b)² = (a + b)² - 4ab

**Calculation:**

Let R and r be the Radii of the two spheres

⇒ R + r = 7 ------- (i)

And

(4/3) × π × R³ + (4/3) × π × r³ = 1144/3

⇒ (4/3) × π × (R³ + r³) = 1144/3

(R³ + r³) = (1144/3) × (3/4) × (7/22)

⇒ (R³ + r³) = 91

Now,

(R³ + r³) = (R + r)³ - 3Rr (R + r) [As (a3 + b3) = (a + b)3 - 3ab (a + b)]

91 = (7)³ - 3Rr (7)

91 = 343 - 21Rr

21Rr = 343 - 91

Rr = 252/21

Rr = 12 -------- (ii)

Similarly, (R - r)² = (R + r)² - 4Rr [As (a - b)2 = (a + b)2 - 4ab]

(R - r)² = (7)² - 4 × 12

(R - r)² = 49 - 48

(R - r)² = 1

R - r = 1 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 1 cm.**

questions.question: A sum becomes three times of itself in 10 years at the rate of simple interest. What is the rate of interest per annum?

questions.question: P, Q, and R invest Rs. 14000, Rs. 18000 and Rs. 24000 respectively to start a business. If the profit at the end of the year is Rs. 25480, then what is the difference between the profit share of P and Q?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Profit Ratio = P : Q : R = 14000 : 18000 : 24000 = 7 : 9 : 12

Difference in ratio parts of P and Q = 9 − 7 = 2 parts

Total ratio parts = 7 + 9 + 12 = 28 parts

Difference in profit share = (2 / 28) × 25480 = 25480 / 14 = 1820

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 1820.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b551c7fe25f81505c020dd76b1ef8a0f57393830a2504a23f8a3f30b5141a2d.png] 

**Given:**

Investment of P = Rs. 14000

Investment of Q = Rs. 18000

Investment of R = Rs. 24000

Total Profit = Rs. 25480

Time period for all = 1 year

**Formula Used:**

Profit Ratio = (Capital of A × Time of A) : (Capital of B × Time of B) : (Capital of C × Time of C)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Profit Ratio of P, Q, and R = (14000 × 1) : (18000 × 1) : (24000 × 1)

⇒ Profit Ratio = 14 : 18 : 24

⇒ Simplified Ratio = 7 : 9 : 12

⇒ Sum of profit ratios = 7 + 9 + 12 = 28

⇒ Difference in profit ratio of P and Q = 9 − 7 = 2

⇒ Difference in profit share = (2 / 28) × 25480

⇒ Difference = (1 / 14) × 25480

⇒ Difference = 1820

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 1820.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple vs Compound Partnership

In a simple partnership, capitals are invested for the same time period. Profit is divided solely in the ratio of the invested capitals. In a compound partnership, the time periods differ, so the profit ratio becomes C₁T₁ : C₂T₂.

Active and Sleeping Partners

An active partner manages the business and usually receives a fixed salary or a specific percentage of the total profit for management duties. The remaining profit is then distributed according to the capital investment ratios among all partners including sleeping partners.

Finding Capital or Time from Profit

If the profit ratio and time ratio are given, Capital Ratio = (P₁ / T₁) : (P₂ / T₂). Conversely, if the profit and capital ratios are given, Time Ratio = (P₁ / C₁) : (P₂ / C₂).

Ten years since Mohit left India and started working for the betterment of the downtrodden people.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Ten years since.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Here, the sentence is incomplete as we don't have a subject and a verb for the object 'ten years'.
 
• Also, the use of **'since'** shows that the first part of the sentence is in the Perfect Tense__.
 
• The present perfect shows that the action of leaving India and starting working for the betterment of the downtrodden people started in the past ten years ago and since the person is still outside India and working on the same thing, the action is still going on.
 
• So, we need to add** 'It has been'** before **'ten years'** to make the sentence complete and grammatically correct. 
 
• In 'it has been', 'it' is the subject, 'has' is the auxiliary (helping) verb and 'been' is the main verb. (been is the past participle (third form of the verb) of 'to-be'.
 
• **Therefore, the complete sentence will be **-*** It has been** ten years since Mohit left India and started working for the betterment of the downtrodden people. *

*​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__***

 
• It is incorrect to say:
 
 
• I know him for ten years.
 
 
 
• The correct way to say this is:
 
 
• I have known him for ten years. [Sub + has\have + the past participle (V3)]

• **Atmosphere -** The envelope of gases surrounding the earth or another planet.

• **Weather - The state of the atmosphere at a place and time as regards heat, dryness, sunshine, wind, rain, etc.**
 
• **Season - **Each of the four divisions of the year (spring, summer, autumn, and winter) marked by particular weather patterns and daylight hours, resulting from the earth's changing position with regard to the sun.

• It may be unpleasant somewhere else but it should be pleasant at the place where we intend to go at the time when we intend to go.
 
• Also, it doesn't have to be pleasant for a long period of time. It can just be pleasant for an hour or a day. 
 
• Therefore,** 'weather'** is the correct word to fill in the blank.

• Whether is a conjunction which is used to express a doubt or choice between alternatives.
